cases.question: Can I return electronics?

reply.answer: Electronics can be returned within 7 days of delivery, provided they are in the original packaging and include all accessories. Note that items marked as "Final Sale" on the product page cannot be returned. For returns, keep the original packaging and accessories intact to be eligible. Refunds are processed after quality checks, and shipping charges are non-refundable unless the item was defective or wrong. Additionally, electronics come with a manufacturer warranty ranging from 6 to 24 months starting from the delivery date, covering manufacturing defects only.
